def adjust_percentages(csv_path):

    with open(csv_path, mode='r', newline='') as infile:
        reader = csv.reader(infile)
        rows = list(reader)

    # Adjust percentages

        if i % 2 == 0:  # Even row (1-based index)
            rows[i][1] = str(float(rows[i][1]) + 5)  # Adjust percentage

            rows[i][1] = str(float(rows[i][1]) - 5)  # Adjust percentage

    # Write the adjusted data back to the CSV file
    with open(csv_path, mode='w', newline='') as outfile:
        writer = csv.writer(outfile)
        writer.writerows(rows)

        print("Usage: python format.py <csv_path>")
        sys.exit(1)
